values.note: Reservable online up to 365 days ahead, but at least one day before arrival ('Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival'), or at 1-888-432-2267. Pets only in the Browning, Beckman and Garrett loops; Delphia Brant is pet-free.

booking.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/deep-creek-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380107 (Booking Window: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/deepcreek.aspx ('Pets are allowed in Browning, Beckman and Garrett Camp Loops'; 'Delphia Brant is a pet-free loop'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/deep-creek-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380107 (per-site details: all 21 'Campsite Electric' sites, Meshach Browning Loop, list 'Electrical Service (amp): 30'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The booking site lists 96 campsites (75 non-electric, 21 electric) in five loops, plus two mini cabins and a yurt; DNR says '82 basic sites and 23 electric sites'. Most take 15-30 ft; the electric sites up to 35 ft and two non-electric sites 40 ft.

sites.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/deep-creek-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380107 (site list: type and Equip length/Driveway for all 103 units) + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/deepcreek.aspx, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Heated bathhouses; freshwater fill-up; free overnight boat-trailer parking and overnight dock slips for campers (first come, first served).

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/deepcreek.aspx (Camping features: 'Heated bathhouses', 'Dump station', 'Freshwater fill up', 'Free boat trailer overnight parking registration', 'Overnight dock slip use') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/deep-creek-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380107 (Services and Amenities: 'Showers', 'Dump Station'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on DNR's park page and the MD booking site: reservable 365 days ahead, closing 1 day before arrival; 30-amp at the 21 electric sites; 96 campsites on the booking site (DNR says 82 + 23) to 40 ft; heated bathhouses/showers, dump, water fill-up. Season (manual) consistent with DNR's 'April 15th to December 15th'. Fees left (manual 2026-10-12). Not stated: weekend/holiday minimums (left inherited), fcfs. Note kept.
